title: Charles Kingston Divorce Case
content: Met with Charles Kingston to discuss the finalization of the divorce settlement. Reviewed the financial aspects and the custody agreement for Emma and Sophia. Charles is adamant about maintaining privacy and ensuring a smooth transition for the twins.

title: National Family Law Association Seminar
content: Attended a seminar on the latest trends in family law. Key takeaways include the impact of social media on divorce proceedings and the importance of prenuptial agreements in high-net-worth marriages.
